facts.fact: Every backend response carries the header `X-FixFlow-Api: 1`, including unknown-route 404s and unhandled-exception 500s, added by an outer ASGI wrapper (O-03 step 1).

Boot refuses the dev default JWT secret, a blank secret, and a secret under 32 bytes unless FIXFLOW_ENVIRONMENT is explicitly `dev` or `test`; the default environment stops being `dev`; CI, Appendix A's gate container and the dev compose set FIXFLOW_ENVIRONMENT=test.
In production, login refuses with 403 ('PIN must be changed by the manager') any account whose hash verifies against a known default PIN (e.g. 1234).
MIN_PIN_DIGITS_TECH becomes 6 and SetPinRequest.pin min_length becomes 6; a 4-digit tech PIN set through the API is refused; backend/scripts/set_pin.py (dry-run default) shares the policy.

A legacy-secret verifier is always built and default OFF: when FIXFLOW_LEGACY_JWT_SECRET is set, a token signed with it is accepted on write routes only, its own exp is not enforced, FIXFLOW_LEGACY_JWT_EXPIRES_AT ends the window, and sub/ver/active checks are kept (O10-F15, ruling R10).
/docs, /redoc and /openapi.json are off in production; login and the WhatsApp webhook get request-body caps (O6-F19/O05-16, O05-14).

Ops-token-gated deep-health exposes default_pin_active per account, the resolved client IP plus raw X-Forwarded-For and CF-Connecting-IP, enable_dispatcher, backup_enabled, backup_prefix, the device_time / jobs-GPS / ping backdate ceilings, the legacy verifier on/off and expiry, and FIXFLOW_GIT_SHA.

The ping backdate ceiling default moves from 48 h to 240 h (O04-F12); CLAUDE.md's location-and-privacy trust-window line is updated to 240 h; /api/ops/health is documented as the healthcheck target with its X-Ops-Proxy-Token requirement (O08-F07).

pytest runs with -rs --junitxml and the gate fails when any @integration test was skipped (same assertion in ci.yml); the mobile job's --passWithNoTests is removed; a CI step fails when CLAUDE.md's Alembic head differs from the down_revision chain head and only warns on unresolved CLAUDE.md paths not in an allow-list file.

One migration-free backend PR, resumed from a draft PR whose body starts `Plan @ <sha>` with Scope checkboxes; first act is this cold-resume trial; if long, deep-health (except default_pin_active and the client-IP echo) moves to P3a and the CI harness items may move to a small P1-ci PR that is never cherry-picked onto release/drain.
